data.name: 1,2,3-Trimethylbenzene with Water
measurement_methods: The concentration of (1) in (2) was then determined by extraction into chloroform followed by UV-spectrophotometry.
mixing_methods: 100-200 cm of (2) and 10-20 cm^3 of liquid (1) were placed in separate but connected thermostatted flasks.
After thermal equilibrium was established a recirculating stream of air was used to vaporize liquid (1) and to transport the vapor to the flask containing (2).

publication_references.citation: Sanemasa, I.; Araki, M.; Deguchi, T.; Nagai, H., Bull. Chem. Soc. Jpn. 1982, 55, 1054-62.
